name: Password Generator
description: Create strong random passwords in your browser, with adjustable length, character sets and an honest strength estimate.
facts: Generates passwords from 8 to 64 characters using the browser's secure random number generator
Starts at a default length of 16 characters
Lets you switch lowercase, uppercase, numbers and symbols on or off, and skip look-alike characters
Guarantees at least one character from every selected group, then shuffles the result
Uses unbiased selection, so no character is more likely than another
Shows an entropy estimate in bits and a plain strength label
Can make five passwords at once and copy the current one with a button
Runs entirely in the browser; passwords are never sent anywhere or stored
limits: The entropy figure is an estimate for a random password and does not apply to passwords you choose yourself
Some websites reject certain symbols, so you may need to turn symbols off
Clipboard copy can be blocked by browser settings
